about.name: Coach Brian
about.bio: I’m a Human Performance Specialist and Strength Coach specializing in helping athletes, military personnel, and everyday individuals optimize performance, health, and longevity. I combine evidence-based training, recovery strategies, nutrition, and lifestyle optimization to improve strength, resilience, and overall readiness. With ten years of coaching experience, I focus on practical, results-driven solutions that help people perform at a high level while staying healthy long term.

hero.headline: Bay County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.
